messages.content: I want to ask my boss for a raise but I have no idea how to bring it up.
Honestly, the opener matters less than people think - just ask for a specific time to talk about compensation directly, don't bury it in a casual chat.
What if they say no though?
Then ask what would need to change for a yes, actually - a 'no' without a path forward is a dead end, but most managers will give you criteria if you ask directly.
That actually makes me feel less nervous about it.
Good, honestly that's the goal - reframing it from a single high-stakes ask into an ongoing conversation takes a lot of the pressure off.
